cards.title: France Defeats South Africa in Nations Championship Rugby Match in Paris

points.text: France 24 and RFI English focus broadly on the match outcome and the end of a long winless streak in Paris, while The Citizen publishes detailed individual player ratings for the Springbok squad.
points.message: summary states 24, which appears in none of the source articles: source it or cut it

cards.title: South Sudan National Elections Commission Postpones National Vote to February 2027

sentences.text: South Sudan has postponed its first national elections from December 22 to February 11, 2027, according to a timetable issued by the National Elections Commission.
